create_choice_parameter: create a Choice parameter that randomly selects one value from a list of categorical options
create_choice_with_repetitions: create a Choice parameter with repetitions to sample multiple independent choices from the same options
create_transition_choice: create a TransitionChoice parameter that selects values with continuous transitions between ordered options
mutate_choice_parameter: mutate a Choice parameter to update softmax weights and the currently selected choice option
get_choice_value_hash: get a hashable value from a Choice parameter representing the current index and nested choice state
